name: feature.commerce.nodes
description: E-Commerce node pack (+ gap plan §5B B5) — catalog, orders, order-ops (fulfill/refund), inventory, and coupons over ctx.features.commerce. Money-adjacent verbs ride the tenant's commerce-spend approval thresholds inside the service (B3).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Commerce: Create order
nodes.description: Create an order from product lines over ctx.features.commerce. Inputs: { orgId, lines:[{productId,quantity}], contactId?, couponCode? }. Output: { order }. role:action (recorded → replay-safe).

nodes.label: Commerce: List products
nodes.description: List the org's products over ctx.features.commerce. Inputs: { orgId, q? }. Output: { products }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Get Product
nodes.description: Fetches one catalog product by id over ctx.features.commerce (org-scoped read). Inputs: { orgId, productId }. Output: the product read model.

nodes.label: Commerce: Get order
nodes.description: Fetch one order over ctx.features.commerce. Inputs: { orgId, orderId }. Output: { order }.

nodes.label: Commerce: List orders
nodes.description: List the org's orders over ctx.features.commerce. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { orders }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Update fulfillment
nodes.description: Advance a paid order's fulfillment (processing/shipped/delivered — delivered flips the order to fulfilled). Inputs: { orgId, orderId, fulfillmentStatus }. Output: { order }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Refund order
nodes.description: Refund a paid/fulfilled order IN FULL. When the tenant has a Stripe key configured this issues a REAL Stripe refund (money leaves); with no key it flips state only. The output order's `refundProvider` says which ran: 'stripe' = money returned, 'none' = recorded only. Inventory restores either way. At/over the tenant's refund threshold this parks a commerce-spend approval and fails with approval_required until a human signs off (B3). Inputs: { orgId, orderId }. Output: { order }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Adjust inventory
nodes.description: Set a physical product's inventory count. Inputs: { orgId, productId, inventory }. Output: { product }.

nodes.label: Commerce: List coupons
nodes.description: List the org's coupons. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { coupons }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Create coupon
nodes.description: Create a coupon (percentage/fixed/free_shipping). Inputs: { orgId, code, type, value, currency? }. `currency` is REQUIRED-in-effect for type `fixed` — a fixed amount is only meaningful in a stated currency, and a fixed coupon whose currency differs from the order's does not apply. Output: { coupon }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Create quote
nodes.description: Draft a quote with C4-resolved (overridable) line prices. Inputs: { orgId, lines:[{productId,quantity,unitPrice?}], contactId?, companyId?, note? }. Output: { quote }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Get quote
nodes.description: Fetch one quote. Inputs: { orgId, quoteId }. Output: { quote }.

nodes.label: Commerce: List quotes
nodes.description: List the org's quotes. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { quotes }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Send quote
nodes.description: Mark a draft quote sent — at/over the tenant's order threshold this parks a commerce-spend approval (approval_required) until a human signs off. Inputs: { orgId, quoteId }. Output: { quote }.

nodes.label: Commerce: Resolve price
nodes.description: The explainable price answer for one product + buyer context (contract entry > variant > list). Inputs: { orgId, productId, variantId?, contactId?, companyId? }. Output: { price, currency, source, priceListName? }.
